name: Hangseng Trader
summary: This EA is a momentum-based trading system designed for the Hang Seng index, generating buy and sell signals from technical indicator crossovers and momentum confirmations. It enters positions when momentum aligns with trend direction and manages exits via fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. The strategy operates systematically without manual intervention, targeting directional moves in the Hang Seng market.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于动量的交易系统,专为恒生指数设计,通过技术指标交叉和动量确认产生买卖信号。当动量与趋势方向一致时开仓,并通过固定的止盈止损水平管理出场。该策略系统性运行,无需人工干预,旨在捕捉恒生市场的方向性行情。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于动量跟踪,利用技术指标的交叉信号和动量确认来判断恒生指数的趋势方向。入场条件通常依赖于快速均线与慢速均线的交叉,或动量指标(如RSI、MACD)的超买超卖区域突破来确认趋势启动。出场条件采用固定的止盈止损设置,在达到预设利润目标时平仓获利,在价格反向运动超过止损阈值时止损出局。仓位管理方面,EA使用固定手数或基于资金的简单仓位计算,没有采用复杂的凯利公式或风险比例仓位管理。资金管理较为简单,主要依赖止损来控制单笔风险,但缺少整体账户风险控制和最大回撤限制机制。整体策略逻辑清晰但偏基础,缺乏自适应市场环境变化的能力。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum tracking, utilizing technical indicator crossover signals and momentum confirmations to determine the trend direction of the Hang Seng index. Entry conditions typically rely on crossovers between fast and slow moving averages, or momentum indicator breakouts from overbought/oversold zones (such as RSI or MACD) to confirm trend initiation. Exit conditions use fixed take-profit and stop-loss settings, closing positions at preset profit targets or cutting losses when price moves adversely beyond the stop threshold. Position sizing employs fixed lot sizes or simple account-balance-based calculations without sophisticated Kelly criterion or risk-proportion methods. Money management is relatively basic, primarily relying on stop-losses for per-trade risk control while lacking holistic account risk controls or maximum drawdown limits. The overall strategy logic is clear but fundamental, lacking adaptability to changing market conditions.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 策略逻辑清晰易懂,基于经典的动量和均线交叉方法,便于理解和维护
具有固定的止盈止损机制,单笔风险可控,不会出现无限制亏损的情况
专为恒生指数设计,对特定市场有一定针对性,参数可根据该市场特性优化
pros_en: Clear and understandable strategy logic based on classic momentum and moving average crossover methods, easy to maintain and modify
Features fixed take-profit and stop-loss mechanisms, keeping per-trade risk controllable without unlimited loss exposure
Specifically designed for the Hang Seng index with targeted parameter optimization potential for that market
cons: 缺乏自适应机制,策略在震荡市和趋势市中无法自动切换,容易在盘整行情中频繁止损
资金管理过于简单,仅依赖固定手数和止损,未考虑账户整体风险敞口和回撤控制
缺少关键的市场环境过滤,如波动率过滤、时段过滤和消息面避让,实盘中可能遭遇滑点和流动性问题
cons_en: Lacks adaptivity mechanism; the strategy cannot auto-switch between ranging and trending markets, leading to frequent stop-outs during consolidation
Money management is overly simplistic, relying only on fixed lots and stop-losses without considering overall account risk exposure or drawdown control
Missing critical market environment filters such as volatility filtering, session filtering, and news event avoidance; may suffer from slippage and liquidity issues in live trading
improvements: 增加市场环境识别模块,如使用ATR或波动率指标区分趋势市和震荡市,在不同环境中切换策略参数或暂停交易
引入动态仓位管理,基于账户风险比例和当前ATR值计算仓位大小,实现风险均衡化
improvements_en: Add a market regime identification module using ATR or volatility indicators to distinguish trending from ranging markets, switching parameters or pausing trading accordingly
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage and current ATR values to achieve risk equalization across trades

risk_points: 缺少最大回撤限制和账户级别的风险控制,极端行情下可能导致连续亏损超出预期
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化,低波动时止损过宽浪费利润,高波动时止盈过窄容易被打掉
未实现新K线检查机制,可能在同一K线上重复开仓导致仓位叠加风险
risk_points_en: No maximum drawdown limit or account-level risk control; extreme market conditions may cause consecutive losses exceeding expectations
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not account for market volatility changes; stops may be too wide in low volatility and take-profits too narrow in high volatility
No new bar check mechanism implemented; may repeatedly open positions on the same bar, causing position stacking risk

summary_en: This EA is a momentum-based trading system designed for the Hang Seng index, generating buy and sell signals from technical indicator crossovers and momentum confirmations. It enters positions when momentum aligns with trend direction and manages exits via fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. The strategy operates systematically without manual intervention, targeting directional moves in the Hang Seng market.
